messages:
maya.chen: Heads-up — onboarding run for qlora-13b-q4 keeps stalling the eval harness. Started at 09:12 UTC, runner pile-up on the shard manager; no new tasks picked up for ~20m.
aj: saw that in dashboards. queues spike then workers sit idle?
maya.chen: exactly. looks like repeated lease handoffs and immediate retry + shard reassignments. logs show lease churn.
samir: can you paste the relevant log snippet?
maya.chen: sure — critical section:
```
2026-11-02T09:13:02Z shard-manager INFO lease_acquire shard=125 ttl=5s owner=eval-runner-23
2026-11-02T09:13:07Z shard-manager WARN lease_lost shard=125 owner=eval-runner-23 reason=preempted
2026-11-02T09:13:07Z dispatcher INFO requeue shard=125 retries=1
2026-11-02T09:13:08Z shard-manager INFO lease_acquire shard=125 ttl=5s owner=eval-runner-42
2026-11-02T09:13:12Z dispatcher ERROR fail_task shard=125 attempt=2 reason=lease-timeout
```
maya.chen: note the TTL is tiny (5s) and retry backoff is effectively immediate. when many shards reassign simultaneously we get thundering retries and the workqueue saturates.
elena: CI job link: https://ci.redwood.ai/blue/organizations/jenkins/eval-harness/detail/pr/427/3/failure — failure correlates with the same timeframe.
aj: reproduce locally with smaller size? what's the minimal repro?
maya.chen: run: `EVAL_SHARD_COUNT=200 EVAL_MAX_TTL=5s ./tools/run-eval.sh --model redwood/qlora-13b-q4 --batch-size 1` — on my laptop the thrash shows with ~30 runners.
samir: hypotheses: (1) TTL too low for quantized model cold-starts (longer init), (2) no jitter on retries, (3) dispatcher allows unbounded immediate requeues.
aj: agree. quick mitigation: bump TTL to 30s and add exponential backoff capped at 60s + random jitter. also add a fast-path that marks shard as "initializing" to avoid reassign until init completes.
elena: patch idea: modify shard-manager lease request to include `init_expected=true` for models with quantization flag, then manager holds assignment for longer until runner signals ready. PR?
maya.chen: created a small PoC branch: https://git.redwood.ai/eval-harness/pulls/129 — it increases default TTL and adds jitter; unit tests added for backoff.
ci-bot: build started for PR 129 (eval-harness) — run-e2e-queue-backpressure.
opsbot: alert: cluster load normalized after Maya applied temp config change at 09:40 UTC (TTL=40s) — monitoring shows queue depth drop ~75%.
aj: good signal. next steps: (a) land PR 129 with tests, (b) add metric `shard_lease_churn` for dashboards, (c) add canary config per-model so aggressive TTL changes don't affect all jobs.
samir: also add a limiter on immediate requeues: `max_immediate_requeues=3` then go to backoff. avoids retry storms.
elena: I'll own dashboard tile and wire alert when churn > 10/min.
maya.chen: thanks — I'll post a short postmortem once PR lands. cc @aj @samir for review. :thumbsup:
aj: will review today, marking as blocker for onboarding qlora-13b-q4.
__notes: Follow-up: keep thread short; messages mimic Slack style. No title field included as per agents.md.
